keepOut.text: Keep out of Hazard Floors 1–2 — enemy Fusion RES is up 10% there — and out of Echoing Floors 2–4, where the bosses resist Fusion. Their home this reset is Resonant Tower.
Keep out of Resonant Tower — every boss there resists Havoc — and out of Hazard Floors 1–2, where Havoc RES is up 10%. They park in Echoing Tower this reset.
Keep out of Hazard Floors 3–4 — both bosses resist Spectro, and Spectro gets no break from the 15% rise there. Their home this reset is Echoing Tower.
Their home this reset is Hazard Floors 1–2. In Hazard Floors 3–4 the 15% rise taxes them — Glacio is not one of the two exempt kinds of damage there.

matrix.resetLine: The current Matrix phase ends Thursday, November 12, 2026 — the last Adversity Vanguard phase opens with Version 3.8.
notes: A boss rush with a deep roster: bosses in succession across two zones, boss HP carries between teams, and your weapons and Echo sets lock to each Resonator for the run.
Vigor is per character: everyone carries 1 and spends it by fighting; healers and shielders carry 2, so they can fight twice. One Emergency Resonator each phase gets +1.
A phase pays 400 Astrite across its reward steps — the score rows ask for about 5,000 points with each team you field.
